preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a < b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) must connect distinct vertices within the range [1, n].
The input must contain exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and isinstance(y, int) and isinstance(y_prime, int) for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
preconditions.description: Each transformation (x, y, y') must consist of three integers.
The number of transformations k must be between 0 and 2n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The transformed graph must remain a tree after all operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation (x, y, y') must involve vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all((x, y) in current_edges and (x, y_prime) not in current_edges for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation must delete an existing edge (x, y) and add a new edge (x, y') that does not already exist.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_transformation(x, y, y_prime, current_edges) for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation must satisfy the condition that |Vx| > |Vy| after deleting edge (x, y), where Vx and Vy are the connected components containing x and y, respectively.
The sum of squared distances between all pairs of vertices in the transformed tree must be minimized.
The output must list exactly k transformations.
